verdict.rationale: AutoGen ships a built-in AssistantAgent that uses an LLM and tools out of the box, and AutoGen Studio provides an interactive environment to configure and run these agents/teams, satisfying the 'built-in assistant to delegate to' story. Community feedback corroborates real usage of the framework but raises performance quality concerns, not a denial of the capability itself. Missing for 10: independent hands-on walkthrough of delegating a specific task to AssistantAgent inside AutoGen Studio's UI, and clearer first-party UI screenshots/video demonstrating end-to-end delegation.
